description: A transmission whose data to the peer needs more than one block at the peer's MAX-SPEED rung is a bulk transmission and goes at that rung.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047). At 1500, during a burst, it sends S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, so TTD 1500 + 1296000000 ms, no confirmation): no SIS output (A-0095), dts.ttd starts (C-1050). At 2000 the burst's one block holds PADDING D_PDUs (type 14) to 0.0.1.2, EOT 10, each carrying one EOW; the PADDING itself is ignored (C-0588). A CAPABILITY with the Ed4 bit records its sender Ed4 (interp C-1261). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). The transmit queue empties, so dts.ttd is cancelled (C-1050). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150; per rung the block bytes and ms given in the config (test data). The DATA C_PDU holds the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD; each type 7 has address size 3, and its EOT and reception window are the half seconds from the start of its block to the end of the burst, rounded up (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node makes no recommendation of its own (corpus-format.md 6.2); sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. The burst from 0.0.1.3 holds CAPABILITY, then MAX-SPEED WN 6 Long (0x8A6), then LOW-SPEED WN 4 Short (0x964: interleaver code 011, speed 4; C-0472). The U_PDU is 300 bytes (0x00 to 0xff, then 0x00 to 0x2b), so its type 7 is more than one 256-byte block of the MAX-SPEED rung: a bulk transmission (open question 7, interp C-1285), which goes at the MAX-SPEED rung WN 6 Long, on the ladder (open question 5, interp C-1280), not at LOW-SPEED. The type 7 (C_PDU ID 0, the whole C_PDU as one segment, dts.max_segment_size 1023) carries SENDER-APPROACH (interp C-1286) and spans two blocks; the rest of the second block is filled with PADDING with CAPABILITY (C-1154), EOT 10, while the type 7, starting in block 0, has EOT and window 20 (C-1043).
